conceptZh: 小玩具機器人戴上一頂大到離譜的金皇冠，整個人被罩住看不見，撞來撞去；他把皇冠推上去之後，三塊長積木疊好、一塊直積木從上面喀一聲插過去，變成「王」。
object: a tiny toy robot, an absurdly oversized golden crown, and chunky interlocking plastic bricks
morph: three long flat bricks settle into the three horizontal strokes and one upright brick drops through their centres to click into the vertical stroke of 王
creativeAngle: 王只有四畫，適合做真正的組裝變形，正好和其他筆畫多的新字互補。笑點用「皇冠大到把人整個蓋住、盲目亂撞」的尺寸落差，再自然接到三橫一豎的積木組裝。語音詞「國王」，國ㄍㄨㄛˊ、王ㄨㄤˊ都用最常見讀音，不會念成破音的ㄨㄤˋ。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid pale gold-cream background. Centered stands a tiny boxy toy robot, and from 0.4 seconds an absurdly oversized golden toy crown lowers onto him and swallows him completely down to his feet. Two little legs stick out underneath. From 1.0 to 2.2 seconds the crown blunders about the centre of frame, bonking gently left and right, one arm poking out to feel for the way. At 2.4 seconds the robot shoves the crown up above his eyes, blinks, and gives a relieved little nod. At 2.8 seconds the crown flattens into three long flat purple bricks that stack into three evenly spaced horizontal bars, the middle one shortest, and the robot sets one upright brick on top and taps it: it drops straight down through the centres of all three with a satisfying click. The robot dusts his hands and hops out of frame to the right at 4.4 seconds. By 4.8 seconds the build has resolved into one correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 王 in saturated deep purple, perfectly centered and uncropped, filling about 70% of the frame height with generous margins, its three horizontal strokes evenly spaced and the single vertical stroke crossing all three. From 4.9 to 8.0 seconds the frame holds completely still on 王 with nothing else moving in the shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no dark or moody grading, no white blowouts. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「王、王、國王」, using the reading ㄨㄤˊ for 王 both on its own and inside the word. Speak the first 王 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 國王 around 5.6 seconds while the finished glyph is held still, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep every sound effect soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not be added to the picture. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 王: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.

conceptZh: 「王」變成皇家停車場，戴著皇冠尾翼的小賽車想停在最上方正中央，卻不停衝過頭。
object: A googly-eyed pull-back toy race car with an integral crown-shaped rear fin, and a solid purple 王-shaped royal parking platform.
morph: The complete glyph remains intact throughout: three horizontal strokes joined at their centers by one vertical stroke. Its top horizontal becomes the race car's royal parking perch.
creativeAngle: 直接讓完整的「王」當皇家停車台，取代皇冠變積木的舊構想。愛耍帥的小賽車左右倒車都衝過頭，最後用小得可笑的一步停準；皇冠是車身一體成形的尾翼，沒有額外道具。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second stylized 3D toy animation in one locked, nearly overhead shot. On a pale warm cream floor, center a flat, saturated purple platform shaped precisely like the Traditional Chinese glyph 王, filling about 70% of frame height with comfortable margins. Its three straight horizontal strokes have clear, even spacing: a medium-length top stroke, a shorter middle stroke, and the longest bottom stroke. One straight central vertical joins all three, ending flush at the top and bottom. Keep the silhouette readable and unchanged throughout, with minimal beveling and shallow shadows.

The sole animated lead is an original squeaky pull-back toy race car with googly eyes, rounded turquoise plastic bodywork, and a small gold crown-shaped rear fin molded into its body. It is proudly determined to park like a king at the exact center of the top horizontal stroke. The platform is the only supporting object; its surface has no lane markings or parking symbols.

At the opening, the tiny car sits at the left end of the top stroke, looking confidently toward its center junction. It rocks backward to wind its mechanism, pauses importantly, then releases at 0.8 seconds. It zips straight past the center and brakes near the right endpoint: its chassis stops, but its googly pupils comically keep sliding right before wobbling back. At 1.7 seconds it glances toward the missed center and reverses with exaggerated confidence. It overshoots again, stopping near the left endpoint at 2.6 seconds with one soft rubber squeak. Keep both overshoots on the straight top bar, with the car much smaller than the glyph. After a sheepish eye wobble, it advances in three absurdly tiny wheel movements, finally reaching the central junction at 3.6 seconds. Its crown fin catches a soft highlight as it proudly lifts its front bumper. Having claimed its royal perch, it turns toward the top of the frame and rolls straight off the shallow platform and completely out of view by 4.6 seconds. From 4.6 through 8.0 seconds, hold completely still on the unobstructed, centered 王 alone.

Use bright, softly lit toy materials and crisp, high-contrast strokes. All cast and objects are unmistakably stylized animation. Keep the comic motion gentle and easy to follow, without flashing effects or visual clutter. The only visible writing is the single 王; include no subtitles, vocabulary text, logos, watermarks, or additional glyphs.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly 「王、王、國王」. Pronounce 王 as ㄨㄤˊ consistently. Speak the first 王 around 0.25 seconds, the second around 1.85 seconds, and 國王 around 5.4 seconds while the finished glyph is fully visible. Allow natural pauses and stop after 國王. Use quiet winding clicks and soft tire squeaks beneath the voice, with no music or additional speech.
